scope: Actual local native-geometry image review and corresponding exact copper analysis. Independent development routing acceptance only.
findings: D302 is vertical on F.Cu at (2,23), 270 degrees. Native pad 1 remains FAULT, pad 2 remains CLR; cathode/anode mapping and original SOD-323 package are preserved.

FAULT exits the upper pad toward the old (2.675,21.15) transfer; the final vertical approach clears the neighboring CLR reference aperture. CLR leaves the lower pad around the left side and reaches its old (1.55,21.1375) transfer. Neither crosses a mounted-face nominal body or any native guard.
CLR 4.106002884 mm and FAULT 1.079594155 mm add no vias. All seven new segments use 0.20 mm width; five original CLR leads are explicitly replaced. No fixed interface or board outline changes.

New FAULT has zero projected overlap with B.Cu DVDT copper and with L701/L901 nominal bodies. G was not adopted after its 0.009842952 mm2 unshielded DVDT overlap was identified; H violated BODY guards; K retained a 0.000568387 mm2 reference defect. L resolves these local findings without relaxing thresholds.

CLR projects onto opposite C1207, a 22uF HEAD_VM-to-GND capacitor. The actual opposite HEAD_VM copper overlap is 0.225246769 mm2 and is covered by intervening ground. This is a local low-power control-signal routing judgment, not a field calculation or measured noise/temperature result.

The old B-side diode position is cleared with its five replaced CLR leads; its adjacent components, source wiring and vias remain. Full-board visual review, complete manufacturer layout, installed face clearance, fault/clear timing, EMC and thermal/physical qualification remain NOT_TESTED.

local_reference_evidence.scope:
Measure a declared R178 candidate's opposite DVDT overlap and ground.

This is geometric source evidence for a local prototype routing review, not a
field simulation, thermal result or qualification of the complete eFuse layout.

manufacturer_sources.review_scope: BAT54WS-7-F SOD323 identity and cathode marking; no component substitution.

DVDT is an analog support node needing short connections and avoidance of switching coupling. C1204 and its original circuit are unchanged; this study does not close complete eFuse layout qualification.
